intent.placement: Daily article hero and Latest card
intent.scenePurpose: People-free graduate job-application tracking desk: open laptop with an empty simple tracker grid, blank ruled application papers, a tabbed document folder and a pencil. No comment slips or classroom context.
intent.viewerUnderstanding: A graduate can organize applications and ask about actual first-job destinations. The scene supplies no measured employment outcome.

companion.exactTextOrSilentPurpose: A graduate study finds a tougher start in AI-exposed majors.

destinationStyleAuthority.rule: Use only adult editorial pop-art grammar, palette and print texture; do not copy people, pose, clothing or composition.

location.rule: No named school, classroom, company, employment office or real person asserted.

era.rule: No historical claim or branded technology.

wardrobeAndAccessories.rule: No graduate costume, cap/gown or named character.

physicalReality.rule: Laptop screen/hinge/keyboard and all desk objects supported with coherent perspective; no humans.

requiredVisualFacts: supported open laptop with coherent screen, hinge and keyboard
empty simple rows/columns on laptop screen, no labels/numbers/marks/data
blank application sheet with empty header box and short ruled lines
tabbed document folder supported on desk
prohibitedContradictions: No people, hands, silhouettes, namedcharacters, MAiVEN or TRAiLBLAZER

No joboffer, rejection, success/failure indicator or employment result
